blocks.title: Level 1 - Dishwasher
blocks.narration: Every great chef started somewhere. Level one is the dish pit, where the night never ends and the plates never stop.

shots.visual_prompt: A young dishwasher seen from behind at a steaming sink in a busy restaurant kitchen at night

shots.narration_span: where the night never ends and the plates never stop.

blocks.title: Level 2 - Line Cook
blocks.narration: Level two is the line. Now you cook, and every ticket is a race against the clock.

shots.visual_prompt: A line cook at a hot grill station with flames, seen from the side, focused expression

shots.narration_span: every ticket is a race against the clock.
